source_refs.title: If you see SOS, No Service, or Searching on your iPhone or iPad - Apple Support
source_refs.section: Try to reconnect to your cellular network
source_refs.applicability: iPhone or iPad; the section gives no model or iOS limit
source_refs.verified_excerpt: If your cellular network is available, you might be able to reconnect by turning Airplane Mode on and off.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On iPhone: If your cellular network is available, you might be able to reconnect by turning Airplane Mode on and off. 1. Open the Settings app. 2. Turn on Airplane Mode for at least 15 seconds. 3. Turn off Airplane Mode.
source_refs.extraction_method: WebFetch of the official page on 2026-11-17; the sentence and the three steps confirmed by exact fetch of the section

source_refs.title: If you see SOS, No Service, or Searching on your iPhone or iPad - Apple Support
source_refs.section: Check for a Carrier Settings update
source_refs.applicability: iPhone or iPad; this check needs Wi-Fi as the section states
source_refs.verified_excerpt: If an update is available, you'll see an option to update your carrier settings.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On iPhone: 1. Make sure that your device is connected to Wi-Fi. 2. Open the Settings app. 3. Tap General. 4. Tap About. If an update is available, you'll see an option to update your carrier settings.

source_refs.title: If you see SOS, No Service, or Searching on your iPhone or iPad - Apple Support
source_refs.applicability: iPhone with a single SIM card or eSIM; the dual SIM branch is not used here
source_refs.verified_excerpt: If you're traveling internationally, make sure that your device is set up for data roaming.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On iPhone with a single SIM card or eSIM: If you're traveling internationally, make sure that your device is set up for data roaming. 1. Open the Settings app. 2. Tap Cellular or Cellular Data. 3. If your device has a single SIM card or eSIM, turn on Cellular Data, then tap Cellular Data Options. 4. Turn on Data Roaming.
